kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-video-cognition-job --title example-title-0000 --params '{"nlpParams":{"sourceLanguage":"cn","diarizationEnabled":true,"speakerCount":2,"summarizationEnabled":true,"summarizationTypes":"Paragraph,Conversational,QuestionsAnswering,MindMap","translationEnabled":true,"targetLanguages":"en","autoChaptersEnabled":true,"meetingAssistanceEnabled":true}}' --user-data '{"test":1}' --input Type=Media Media=c5c62d8f03613000000000000c6d --template-id 39f8e0bc00000000000000000 --template-config example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitVideoCognitionJob

parameters.help_en: The video title. The title supports Chinese characters, English letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It cannot start with a special character and cannot exceed 256 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 视频标题，支持中英文、数字、中划线（-），不能以特殊符号开头，长度不能超过 256B
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The additional request parameters, represented as a JSON string. This parameter supports additional parameters for operators such as natural language processing, shot detection, custom tagging, and action recognition
parameters.help_zh: 额外的请求参数，使用 JSON 字符串表示。支持自然语言处理，分镜，自定义标签，动作识别等算子的额外参数
parameters.name: params

parameters.help_en: The user-defined data. The data is returned as-is when the result is retrieved. The length cannot exceed 1,024 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，获取结果时原样返回。长度不超过 1024 字节
parameters.name: user_data

fields.help_en:
If the Type parameter is set to OSS, specify the OSS address, such as OSS://test-bucket/video/202208/test.mp4.

If the Type parameter is set to Media, specify the mediaId, such as c5c62d8f0361337cab312dce8e77dc6d.

If the Type parameter is set to URL, specify the HTTP URL, such as https://zc-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/test/unknowFace.mp4
fields.help_zh:
上述 Type 参数设置为 OSS 时，写 OSS 地址，例如：OSS://test-bucket/video/202208/test.mp4

Type 为 Media 时写 mediaId：c5c62d8f0361337cab312dce8e77dc6d

Type 为 URL 时写 http url，例如：https://zc-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/test/unknowFace.mp4
fields.name: media

fields.help_en:
The media type. Valid values:

OSS

Media

URL
fields.help_zh:
媒体类型，支持以下三种类型：

OSS

Media

URL
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The template ID used to specify the analysis algorithm. For template-related operations, refer to Create a custom template (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ims/developer-reference/api-ice-2020-11-09-createcustomtemplate) and Smart tagging template (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ims/user-guide/smart-tagging-template)
parameters.help_zh: 模板 ID 用于指定分析算法，模板相关操作参见创建用户自定义模板 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ims/developer-reference/api-ice-2020-11-09-createcustomtemplate?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-193643.d_5_0_3_3_0_0.17b66afamjKySv)和智能标签模版 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ims/user-guide/smart-tagging-template?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i15)
parameters.name: template_id
